# Question coverage and source mapping

[← All question groups](index.md) · Source audit date: 2026-10-11

<p>This report joins the preserved sources to the existing catalog and the canonical question bank. Numbered prompts, unnumbered scenarios, source advice, generated lesson questions, lab examples and template prompts have different roles. The six source files were read in full; headings and summaries were not substituted for their bodies.</p>

<p>234 numbered source prompts + 4 source scenarios = 238 source units. 10 duplicate pairs consolidate into 228 canonical questions across 46 existing catalog groups and 13 domains. Unprocessed source units: 0.</p>

<p>Scenario steps are constraints, not additional questions. The seven-step answer-structure section in S06 is retained as advice, not counted as a question. The catalog has 47 topics; algorithms-collection-reasoning is derived Ring B practice and has no canonical source-question home. S03-Q032 uses the existing focused department-headcount topic; its older broad source-topic anchor remains unchanged. Counts below assign merged questions to the lowest stable source ID, not to every file in which an alias appears. No version-specific model answers or benchmark results are asserted here.</p>

## Documented semantic merges (10)

- **[S01-Q010](groups/ef-query-execution.md#S01-Q010)** ← S01-Q010, S02-Q025: Both compare IEnumerable/IQueryable; preserve execution timing and provider scope.
- **[S01-Q032](groups/dotnet-di-solid.md#S01-Q032)** ← S01-Q032, S01-Q037: Shared DIP/DI comparison; retain IoC explicitly from Q032.
- **[S01-Q042](groups/architecture-boundaries.md#S01-Q042)** ← S01-Q042, S04-Q003: Identical Clean Architecture and dependency-direction prompt.
- **[S04-Q024](groups/messaging-idempotent-consumer.md#S04-Q024)** ← S04-Q024, S04-Q025: Same duplicate-effect/idempotent-consumer contract under repeated delivery.
- **[S04-Q015](groups/architecture-api-gateway.md#S04-Q015)** ← S04-Q015, S05-Q024: Shared gateway responsibility contract; retain reverse-proxy and API-management contexts.
- **[S02-Q019](groups/aspnet-background-jobs.md#S02-Q019)** ← S02-Q019, S05-Q044: Same offload decision; retain resource-intensive work as the concrete context.
- **[S02-Q023](groups/aspnet-background-jobs.md#S02-Q023)** ← S02-Q023, S05-Q046: Same multi-replica scheduler safety question; retain scheduled/background scope.
- **[S04-Q013](groups/reliability-dependency-failures.md#S04-Q013)** ← S04-Q013, S05-Q045: Shared retry-storm policy; retain timeout, backoff and circuit-breaker constraints.
- **[S04-Q023](groups/messaging-delivery-recovery.md#S04-Q023)** ← S04-Q023, S05-Q047: Shared recovery policy for repeatedly failing work; retain retry and poison/dead-letter scope.
- **[S05-Q027](groups/azure-operations-iac.md#S05-Q027)** ← S05-Q027, S05-Q038: Same environment configuration contract; retain cloud deployment and immutable container/artifact contexts.
